recap.paragraph: In Cleveland, the Browns hoped to end a 2-game losing streak. Houston jumped ahead 17-0 on a touchdown pass to Xavier Hutchinson. Deshaun Watson ran for a score, and KC Concepcion tied it at 17-17. Then C.J. Stroud found Dalton Schultz to put Houston back on top. The Browns had one more comeback in them! Quinshon Judkins ran 5 yards for the winning touchdown with 53 seconds left. Cleveland won 27-24 and moved to 6-4.
